text: @dsh-external/dsh-default-workspace 是面向 Web 客户端的 DSH 插件，可在新 profile 没有工作区时自动创建并注册默认工作区，也在新会话选择器中加入「不在工作区中对话」入口。启动端按配置、环境变量和默认目录解析路径，支持自定义显示名；客户端入口创建未关联工作区的会话。适合希望首次启动即可聊天，或需要在工作区之外开启会话的用户。可选设置 DSH_DEFAULT_WORKSPACE、DSH_HOME 或插件配置；不需要 API 密钥。

@dsh-external/dsh-default-workspace is a web add-on that creates and registers a default directory when a profile has no workspaces. It adds “Chat without a workspace” to the session picker to open an ungrouped chat. Set an optional path, title, or always flag; no API key is needed.
全新安装后没有工作区，怎样直接开始聊天？
让 Web 版 DSH 首次启动时自动准备一个工作目录。
我想开一个不归属任何工作区的新会话。
工作区列表为空时卡在选择页面，有办法绕过吗？
Can I start a chat without choosing a workspace first?
Set up a default working directory automatically for a fresh web profile.
I need an ungrouped conversation that is not attached to a project folder.
怎样指定新建默认工作区放在哪个目录？
@dsh-external/dsh-default-workspace 的功能「首次启动准备工作区」：Web 启动时若注册表为空，解析默认目录、创建目录并注册工作区；已有工作区时默认跳过。
@dsh-external/dsh-default-workspace 的功能「无工作区会话」：在新会话工作区选择器选择新增入口，即创建并打开未附加工作区的会话。
@dsh-external/dsh-default-workspace 的功能「自定义默认目录」：可用插件 path 配置或 DSH_DEFAULT_WORKSPACE 覆盖默认位置；相对配置路径以进程当前目录解析。
@dsh-external/dsh-default-workspace 的功能「中英文选择器入口」：扫描工作区菜单并按现有添加行复制样式，加入中文或英文的无工作区选项。
使用前须知：默认工作区会按需在宿主机创建目录；无工作区会话使用宿主当前工作目录，因此会从该目录开始。

@dsh-external/dsh-default-workspace README · Introduction：

dsh-default-workspace

A DeepSeek Harness plugin — start a new conversation without selecting a workspace.

@dsh-external/dsh-default-workspace README · Introduction：Out of the box, DeepSeek Harness will not let a conversation start until a workspace directory has been selected. On a fresh profile the workspace registry is empty, so the web GUI lands on the workspace-picker hero and there is nothing to pick.

This plugin removes that dead-end in two ways, from one package:

@dsh-external/dsh-default-workspace README · Introduction：1. **Node half** — at boot it resolves a default workspace directory, creates it if missing, and registers it. The runtime's existing "recent workspace" fallback then connects it, so a brand-new profile opens straight into a conversation.
2. **Client half** — it adds a **"Chat without a workspace"** (`不在工作区中对话`) entry to the new-session workspace picker. Selecting it starts a session with **no workspace**: its working directory falls back to the host's `process.cwd()` and the session shows up as *Ungrouped* in the sidebar.

@dsh-external/dsh-default-workspace README · What it does：| Behaviour | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Auto-provision | Creates and registers a default workspace on first boot |
| No-workspace option | Adds a "Chat without a workspace" row to the workspace picker |
| Zero footprint | Auto-provision is a no-op when workspaces already exist (unless `always: true`) |
| Idempotent | Re-registering the same path reuses the existing record |
| Non-fatal | A failure is logged as a warning and never fails the boot |
| Zero dependencies | Imports only Node built-ins / browser APIs; no build step |

@dsh-external/dsh-default-workspace README · What it does：The default directory is `<DSH_HOME>/workspaces/default` (or `~/.dsh/workspaces/default` when `DSH_HOME` is unset). It can be overridden per-deployment with a config row, or globally with the `DSH_DEFAULT_WORKSPACE` environment variable.

text: @dsh-external/dsh-default-workspace README · Configuration：Overrides live on the plugin's config row in the profile `cordis.patch.yml` (the `cordis.patch.yml` shipped by this package shows the full template). Precedence is `config.path` → `DSH_DEFAULT_WORKSPACE` → `<DSH_HOME>/workspaces/default`.

@dsh-external/dsh-default-workspace README · Configuration：| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | `<DSH_HOME>/workspaces/default` | Default workspace directory; `~` expands to the OS home, a relative path resolves against the process cwd |
| `title` | string | `Default` | Display title for the workspace |
| `always` | boolean | `false` | `true` always ensures the workspace, even when others already exist |

Or set the environment variable before launching:

```sh
DSH_DEFAULT_WORKSPACE="$HOME/projects/scratch" dsh web
```

@dsh-external/dsh-default-workspace README · Usage：Install, restart the web profile, and go — no commands, no tools. A brand-new profile opens directly into a conversation in the default workspace, and the workspace picker on a new session offers **"Chat without a workspace"** to start an ungrouped conversation instead.

@dsh-external/dsh-default-workspace README · Development：There is no build step: both halves ship as plain JavaScript.

```
src/index.mjs        — the node half (ensure + register the default workspace)
src/client/index.js  — the client half (the "Chat without a workspace" picker entry)
cordis.patch.yml     — the bundle patch that mounts the node half
```
